cat > /root/autodl-tmp/cleanup_checkpoints.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
# Rolling checkpoint cleanup: keep newest 2 *_chkpt dirs per seed
for seed_dir in /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/occ_s0 /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/occ_s1 /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/occ_s2; do
  if [ -d "$seed_dir" ]; then
    # Find checkpoint dirs matching pattern *--*_chkpt
    chkpts=$(find "$seed_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '*_chkpt' 2>/dev/null | sort -t'-' -k2 -n)
    count=$(echo "$chkpts" | grep -c .)
    if [ "$count" -gt 2 ]; then
      to_delete=$(echo "$chkpts" | head -n -2)
      for d in $to_delete; do
        rm -rf "$d"
        echo "$(date): Deleted $d" >> /root/autodl-tmp/cleanup.log
      done
      echo "$(date): Cleaned $seed_dir, kept newest 2 of $count" >> /root/autodl-tmp/cleanup.log
    fi
  fi
done
df -h /root/autodl-tmp/ >> /root/autodl-tmp/cleanup.log
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/cleanup_checkpoints.sh
